accepted.evidence: Turner tr̥pra (5934) explicitly gives Khowar trup salt, also radish. Bashir confirms trup/thrup. Although Bashir cites T5848, the full tīvrá entry only cross-references Khowar trup to tr̥pra; 5934 is therefore the exact parent. Final aspiration in the survey is retained, not silently normalized.

Turner explicitly separates Khowar c̣hui hunger under *kṣudhikā (section 2) from c̣hui hungry under *kṣudhin (section 3). The survey adjective belongs to section 3; Bashir confirms c̣huy hungry beside c̣huí hunger. The local renderings differ in aspiration and vowel notation but preserve the diagnostic retroflex affricate and predicate meaning.
